system.description:
You perform powerful attack with enough force to penetrate steel, blasting through your enemy. Make a ranged taijutsu attack against the target, dealing your [Weapon’s damage] +3d10 and all creatures in a 20-foot line behind the target must make a Dexterity saving throw, or take 3d10 damage of the same type your weapon deals on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

Chain 2: Increase the length of the Line to 40 feet.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 2d10.
